Two values are considered the same household field when they match after 27 * trimming, collapsing every run of whitespace to a single space, and lower-casing. 28 * This is the comparison used to detect owners living in the same household. 29 */ 30 @Component 31 public class HouseholdNormalizer { 32 33 /** 34 * Reduce {@code value} to its canonical form for case-insensitive, 35 * whitespace-insensitive comparison. 36 * 37 * @param value the raw field value (may be {@code null}) 38 * @return the normalized value, or an empty string when {@code value} is {@code null} 39 */ 40 public String normalize(String value) { 41 if (value == null) { 42 return ""; 43 } 44 return value.strip().replaceAll("\\s+", " ").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT); 45 } 46 } 47

The identifier is derived deterministically from the household's identity 25 * (last name, canonicalized by {@link HouseholdNormalizer}, and postcode), so every 26 * owner sharing a last name and postcode resolves to the same value automatically, 27 * regardless of registration order. 28 */ 29 @Component 30 public class HouseholdIdGenerator { 31 32 private static final int ID_LENGTH = 12; 33 34 private final HouseholdNormalizer householdNormalizer; 35 36 public HouseholdIdGenerator(HouseholdNormalizer householdNormalizer) { 37 this.householdNormalizer = householdNormalizer; 38 } 39 40 /** 41 * Build the household identifier shared by owners with the given last name and 42 * postcode: the first {@value #ID_LENGTH} upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over 43 * {@code normalize(lastName) + "|" + postcode}. 44 * 45 * @param lastName the household's last name 46 * @param postcode the household's postcode 47 * @return a stable, upper-case hexadecimal identifier for the household 48 */ 49 public String generate(String lastName, String postcode) { 50 String key = householdNormalizer.normalize(lastName) + "|" + postcode; 51 return Sha256Hex.upperHexPrefix(key, ID_LENGTH); 52 } 53 } 54

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility
            when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied. On output it is the
            composed, normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is
            present, or the normalized flat address when only the flat form was given.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized like the flat address on create.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or suite). Normalized like the flat address on create and, when
            present, appended to 'addressLine1' in the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When supplied it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on input; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Returned in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied it is used to derive the ageBand relative to the registrationDate. Returned in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner already belongs to its household (same last name and postcode, i.e. the same computed householdId); the owner is recorded as a declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Without it, a second owner in an existing household is rejected as a duplicate (409). Input only; not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for human display, being the calling code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone followed by the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household, derived deterministically as the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode ('normalizedLastName|postcode'). Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically. Absent when no postcode was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of owners that already existed at the moment this owner was created sharing the same first name and last name (compared case-insensitively). Captured once at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, starting at 0; add 2 when an email address is present; add 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for qualifying tenure (more than 365 days since registration).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, being the region segment of the customerCode (the '<REGION>' of '<REGION>-<HASH8>'), fixed at creation from the postcode (preferred, matched against the known region ranges) falling back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's timezone, being the IANA timezone name derived from the locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the locality has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, being 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate as of the registrationDate, being 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' when 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived value all duplicate detection is based on, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + (householdId or empty). A new owner is rejected as a duplicate only when its whole identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been registered on this owner's registration date at the moment it was created (an unusually high-volume signup day); otherwise false. Captured once at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner was flagged at creation as a possible (soft) duplicate of an existing owner; otherwise false. Because owners sharing a last name and postcode are now the same household - rejected as a household duplicate unless declared via 'sharesHousehold', and a declared member is not a suspected duplicate - this flag is not raised at creation. Captured once at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible (soft) duplicate of at creation, or absent when it is not a possible duplicate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I added a structured address form to the owner-creation flow while keeping the flat `address` fully backward-compatible.

**API contract (`openapi.yml`)**
- Added optional `addressLine1` and `addressLine2` to `OwnerFields` (so they also appear on the `Owner` response via `allOf`).
- Removed `address` from the `required` list so a structured-only request isn't rejected by Bean Validation; the "either form, plus city" rule is enforced in code where it can return the proper error.

**Persistence**
- Added `addressLine1` / `addressLine2` fields (with `address_line1` / `address_line2` columns) to the `Owner` entity, with documented getters/setters.
- Added the two columns to all four schema dialects (hsqldb — used by the tests — plus h2, mysql, postgres).

**Address logic (each piece in its own place)**
